description: This file defines API endpoints for managing 'boards' in a FastAPI application, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting boards. It uses SQLModel for database session management and depends on repository classes for data operations.

classes.name: BoardRepository
classes.description: Repository class responsible for CRUD operations on 'Board' data.

methods.name: list_boards(session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET to list all boards.

methods.name: create_board(payload: BoardCreate, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST to create a new board.

methods.name: get_board(board_id: int, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET to retrieve a specific board by ID.

methods.name: update_board(board_id: int, payload: BoardUpdate, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT to update a board by ID.

methods.name: delete_board(board_id: int, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE to delete a board by ID.

ctags.name: update_board
ctags.pattern: /^def update_board(board_id: int, payload: BoardUpdate, session: Session = Depends(get_session)):$/
ctags.signature: (board_id: int, payload: BoardUpdate, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
